# laravelforge_daemon (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge daemon (background process) by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the daemon.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the daemon runs on.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Command the daemon runs.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `directory` (String) Working directory the command runs in.
- `processes` (Number) Number of processes to run.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `user` (String) User account the command runs under.
